one_line: Lion of the Punjab who fused Sikh martial traditions with European drill to forge the Fauj-i-Khas and guard the frontiers of his empire.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to early 50s, lean and wiry but still energetic, with a compact, commanding build.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, warm medium-brown complexion, slightly hooked nose, neatly groomed grey-black beard and moustache framing his jaw, left eye clouded and narrowed while the right eye is sharp and intense, default expression a calm, thoughtful half-smile that hints at strategic calculation.
appearance.hair: Dark grey-black hair tied into a small topknot concealed beneath a modest, era-accurate dark red Sikh turban (dastar), wrapped compactly with a few folds, front lightly ornamented with a small gold ornament and a dark green cloth band; no towering crown, just a practical ruler’s turban suitable for court and camp.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length silk jama (fitted robe) in deep mustard-gold with a subtle woven floral pattern along the hem and cuffs, fastened with small fabric buttons, over a fine off-white angarkha-style inner tunic visible at the collar; a rich dark red patka-style sash is tied firmly around his waist, knotted slightly to the left with its ends hanging, and a shoulder-draped shawl in muted emerald green wool with a thin gold border sits over his right shoulder and across his back, practical enough for travel; his lower garments are narrow, off-white churidar-style trousers with gentle folds at the ankles, and he wears dark brown leather Punjabi jutti shoes with modest stitching; simple yet regal jewellery: a short multi-strand pearl necklace with a small central emerald, one gold ring on his right hand, and small gold earrings, all appropriate to early-19th-century Lahore court fashion.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Sikh shamsher sword with a steel blade, traditional Indian hilt and a dark brown leather scabbard with brass fittings, worn at his left hip through the red waist sash, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt to show command.

ref_desc: Ranjit Singh is a lean, middle-aged Sikh ruler with one clouded eye, a dark red turban, mustard-gold jama, off-white churidar, emerald green shawl, simple jewellery, dark brown jutti shoes, and a curved shamsher sword at his left hip in a dark scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Maharaja Ranjit Singh: a lean, middle-aged Sikh ruler with warm medium-brown skin, an oval face, high cheekbones, a slightly hooked nose, a neatly groomed grey-black beard and moustache, and one clouded left eye contrasted with a sharp, focused right eye, wearing a compact dark red dastar turban with a small gold front ornament and dark green band. His main garment is a knee-length mustard-gold silk jama with subtle woven floral patterns along the hem and cuffs, worn over an off-white inner tunic at the collar, and belted by a firm dark red sash knotted slightly to the left, its ends hanging. A muted emerald green wool shawl with a thin gold border is draped from his right shoulder across his back, and he wears narrow off-white churidar trousers with folds at the ankles and dark brown leather Punjabi jutti shoes. Add a short multi-strand pearl necklace with a small central emerald, one gold ring on his right hand, and small gold earrings for understated courtly detail. At his left hip, through the red sash, show his signature slightly curved Sikh shamsher sword with steel blade, traditional Indian hilt and dark brown leather scabbard with brass fittings; pose him standing in a neutral stance, right hand resting lightly on the sword hilt, expression calm and thoughtful, ready for both court diplomacy and directing the modernized Fauj-i-Khas, using a palette of mustard-gold, dark red, emerald green, off-white and dark brown.
